message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are visible anywhere in the data-acquisition path; data from get_data() is used directly without validation.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data paths are read from a local YAML config file and no remote fetching, checksum verification, signed URLs, or authentication is present in the code.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no code that validates label values against an expected set, compares label distributions, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples is performed anywhere in the visible pipeline code.

No detected model integrity verification: The code builds models from scratch via get_model() and saves/loads checkpoints using torch's state_dict without any hash verification, signature check, or pinned revision control.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse, activation-pattern analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor defense in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: Standard Adam and SGD optimizers are used with no Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, or DP-SGD mechanisms applied.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the evaluation code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While a separate test_loader is used, there is no isolation enforcement, hashing/signing of evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation; only AUC is computed.
No detected input sanitization: The inference path directly passes test batches to the model without any shape, range, or schema validation checks.

No detected output bounds checks: The code collects predictions into y_pred/y_target lists and computes AUC but performs no NaN guards, probability bounds checks, or sanity validation on model outputs.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is an ECG/time-series classification model (ResNet-based), not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
